pages.title: Anime Girl in School Uniform Coloring Page
pages.description: In this printable coloring page, an anime girl grips her schoolbag strap while standing in a sailor uniform with a pleated skirt and knee socks. A flag flies above the school building behind her.

pages.title: Anime Boy with Headphones Coloring Page
pages.description: An anime boy adjusts his headphones in this printable coloring page, sitting cross-legged in a hooded sweatshirt with the cord trailing toward his sneakers. The lace loops and drawstrings add smaller shapes to color.

pages.title: Chibi Girl with Teddy Bear Coloring Page
pages.description: A chibi girl hugs a teddy bear in this printable coloring page, with a big hair bow, ruffled sleeves, and two hearts beside her. The bear has a bow tie and round paw pads.

pages.title: Chibi Boy in Dinosaur Hoodie Coloring Page
pages.description: In this printable coloring page, a chibi boy raises both hands while wearing a dinosaur hoodie with pointed teeth, back spikes, and a long tail. Small tufts of grass sit around his sneakers.

pages.title: Anime Cat Girl Coloring Page
pages.description: A kneeling anime cat girl curls her hands like paws in this printable coloring page, wearing a bell at her neck and a layered skirt. Her pointed ears and curling tail frame the pose.

pages.title: Anime Magical Girl with Star Wand Coloring Page
pages.description: An anime magical girl holds a star wand in this printable coloring page, with star-shaped earrings, bows on her boots, and long twin ponytails. A few floating stars surround her flared skirt.

pages.title: Anime Girl in Kimono Coloring Page
pages.description: An anime girl holds a parasol in this printable coloring page, wearing a kimono with flower motifs, wide sleeves, and a large obi bow. A low bridge railing curves behind her sandals.

pages.title: Anime Girl with Butterfly Wings Coloring Page
pages.description: In this printable coloring page, an anime girl with butterfly wings kneels among flowers, her hands resting on the ground below her puffed sleeves. Rounded markings divide the wings into open coloring areas.

pages.title: Anime Girl Playing Electric Guitar Coloring Page
pages.description: An anime girl plays an electric guitar in this printable coloring page, with a shoulder strap, a cable leading to an amplifier, and stars around her. Small knobs and fret markers break up the guitar’s broad shapes.

pages.title: Anime Girl Eating Ramen Coloring Page
pages.description: An anime girl lifts noodles to her mouth with chopsticks in this printable coloring page, holding a ramen bowl topped with an egg and fish cake. A repeating pattern runs around the rim.

pages.title: Anime Girl at a Cat Cafe Coloring Page
pages.description: An anime girl pets a cat on her lap in this printable coloring page, seated beside a café table with a cup and cupcake. A cat tower and a paw-print window decorate the room.

pages.title: Anime Witch on Broom Coloring Page
pages.description: An anime witch grips a flying broom in this printable coloring page, with a pointed hat, a sweeping cape, and buckles on her boots. A crescent moon and a few clouds mark the sky.

pages.title: Anime Mermaid Princess Coloring Page
pages.description: An anime mermaid princess holds a shell-topped scepter in this printable coloring page, wearing a crown and a beaded necklace above her curved tail. The broad tail and split fin offer open spaces to color.

pages.title: Anime Couple Under an Umbrella Coloring Page
pages.description: An anime couple stands under one umbrella in this printable coloring page, wearing long coats and lace-up shoes on a path framed by shrubs. One holds the curved handle while the other gathers her scarf.

pages.title: Anime Best Friends at a Festival Coloring Page
pages.description: Two anime friends stand beneath festival lanterns in this printable coloring page, wearing floral yukata and sandals while one waves and the other holds cotton candy. A stall canopy peeks out behind them.

pages.title: Anime Skateboard Boy Coloring Page
pages.description: In this printable coloring page, an anime boy crouches beside his upright skateboard, flashing a peace sign in a backward cap and lace-up sneakers. The board’s wheels and trucks face forward beside a skate ramp.

pages.title: Anime Ninja with Throwing Stars Coloring Page
pages.description: An anime ninja brandishes a throwing star in this printable coloring page, with another star tucked in a belt pouch beneath a flowing scarf. Wrapped forearms and boots frame the wide stance.

pages.title: Anime Samurai Under Cherry Blossoms Coloring Page
pages.description: An anime samurai rests a hand on his sheathed sword in this printable coloring page, wearing wide hakama and sandals beneath a flowering cherry tree. Loose petals surround his tied-back hair.

pages.title: Anime Mecha Robot Coloring Page
pages.description: A mecha robot stands with both fists lowered in this printable coloring page, with a rounded visor, broad shoulder plates, and a cross on its chest. Panel seams separate the armor into large coloring areas.

pages.title: Anime Dragon and Its Rider Coloring Page
pages.description: An anime rider holds the reins of a dragon in this printable coloring page, sitting above its clawed feet, folded wings, and curling spiked tail. A cape and stirrup distinguish the rider from the saddle.

pages.title: Anime Eyes and Expressions Coloring Page
pages.description: An anime girl holds a chart of eyes and expressions in this printable coloring page, with examples of winking, crying, surprise, and anger. A large bow and sailor collar frame the chart.

pages.title: Anime Girl Walking in a Snowy City Coloring Page
pages.description: An anime girl walks through a snowy city in this printable coloring page, carrying a shoulder bag past snow-covered shrubs, a lamppost, and tall buildings. Her knit hat and scarf frame her face.

pages.title: Anya Forger in School Uniform Coloring Page
pages.description: Anya Forger raises a fist in this printable coloring page, wearing her school uniform with scalloped trim, a backpack, and pointed hair accessories. Her shoes and cuffs have small enclosed details.

pages.title: Yor Forger as Thorn Princess Coloring Page
pages.description: Yor Forger poses as the Thorn Princess in this printable coloring page, gripping two pointed weapons while wearing rose hair ornaments and heeled boots. Long dress panels hang behind her legs.

pages.title: Loid Forger in a Spy Suit Coloring Page
pages.description: Loid Forger carries a briefcase in this printable coloring page, wearing a three-piece spy suit with a tie, a lapel pin, and lace-up dress shoes. The background leaves his outline clear.

pages.title: Anya Riding Bond Coloring Page
pages.description: Anya rides Bond in this printable coloring page, leaning forward with her hands on his head above his bow tie and shaggy chest. His fluffy tail curves up beside her shoe.

pages.title: Sailor Moon with Luna Coloring Page
pages.description: Sailor Moon kneels with Luna in this printable coloring page, holding the crescent-marked cat between her arms while twin ponytails curl around her boots. A moon and stars sit above them.

pages.title: Sailor Chibi Moon with Her Pink Moon Stick Coloring Page
pages.description: Sailor Chibi Moon holds her Pink Moon Stick in this printable coloring page, with twin buns, a sailor collar, and tall boots beneath a pleated skirt. A crescent and heart shape decorate the wand.

pages.title: Sailor Jupiter Using Supreme Thunder Coloring Page
pages.description: Sailor Jupiter summons Supreme Thunder in this printable coloring page, holding her fists near her chest as lightning bolts frame her ponytail and lace-up boots. Two bolts rise from her tiara.

pages.title: Haikyuu Hinata Spiking a Volleyball Coloring Page
pages.description: Shoyo Hinata leaps to spike a volleyball in this printable coloring page, reaching toward the ball beside the net in his number 10 jersey. Both shoes are visible beneath his bent knees.

pages.title: Haikyuu Kageyama Setting the Volleyball Coloring Page
pages.description: Tobio Kageyama sets a volleyball above his forehead in this printable coloring page, standing with raised hands in his number 9 jersey and knee pads. His lace-up shoes angle outward.

pages.title: Haikyuu Nishinoya Receiving a Volleyball Coloring Page
pages.description: Yu Nishinoya crouches to receive a volleyball in this printable coloring page, clasping his hands in front of his number 4 jersey and knee pads. Straight lines mark the gym floor beneath his shoes.

pages.title: Blue Lock Isagi Shooting a Soccer Ball Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoichi Isagi shoots a soccer ball in this printable coloring page, following through in his number 11 jersey with a goal behind him. The lifted cleat and curved motion lines show the kick.

pages.title: Blue Lock Bachira Dribbling a Soccer Ball Coloring Page
pages.description: Meguru Bachira dribbles a soccer ball in this printable coloring page, leaning forward in a number 8 jersey with one cleat beside the ball. Short tufts of grass mark the field.

pages.title: Blue Lock Nagi Trapping a Soccer Ball Coloring Page
pages.description: Seishiro Nagi traps a soccer ball with his raised thigh in this printable coloring page, wearing a number 7 jersey and striped socks. His planted cleat sits beside a low field barrier.

pages.title: One Punch Man Saitama with Grocery Bags Coloring Page
pages.description: Saitama carries two grocery bags in this printable coloring page, walking in a cape and boots with vegetables and a bottle visible above the handles. A low wall runs beside the sidewalk.

pages.title: One Punch Man Genos Using His Incineration Cannon Coloring Page
pages.description: Genos fires his incineration cannon in this printable coloring page, sending a jagged blast from one mechanical palm while keeping his other fist lowered. Jointed arm plates and scattered rubble frame his stance.

pages.title: One Punch Man Tatsumaki Lifting Rocks Coloring Page
pages.description: Tatsumaki lifts rocks around herself in this printable coloring page, spreading both hands as her curled hair and long dress panels sweep outward. Broken stones also lie beside her heels.

pages.title: Cardcaptor Sakura with the Clow Cards Coloring Page
pages.description: Sakura holds a fan of Clow Cards and a winged staff in this printable coloring page, wearing a frilled dress and bow-trimmed shoes. Stars and crescents decorate the card backs.

pages.title: Cardcaptor Sakura Kero Eating Cake Coloring Page
pages.description: Kero lifts a bite of cake to his mouth in this printable coloring page, holding a plate with a layered slice and strawberry topping. Small wings and a tufted tail frame his seated pose.

pages.title: Cardcaptor Sakura Syaoran with His Sword Coloring Page
pages.description: Syaoran holds his sword in both hands in this printable coloring page, with a round hat, wide sleeves, and a tassel hanging from the hilt. Clouds sit inside the rectangular border.

pages.title: Inuyasha with Tessaiga Coloring Page
pages.description: Inuyasha grips Tessaiga with both hands in this printable coloring page, with his hair sweeping behind his robe and a beaded necklace at his collar. The broad blade curves above its furry guard.

pages.title: Kagome with Her Bow and Arrow Coloring Page
pages.description: Kagome holds her bow and a separate arrow in this printable coloring page, standing in her sailor uniform with the bowstring drawn as a straight line. The arrow’s fletching and pointed head remain visible.

pages.title: Sango Riding Kirara Coloring Page
pages.description: Sango rides Kirara in this printable coloring page, leaning forward in armor with her boomerang rising behind her and Kirara’s two tails sweeping upward. Four paws show beneath the leaping body.

pages.title: Spirited Away Chihiro on the Train Coloring Page
pages.description: Chihiro sits on a train bench in this printable coloring page, resting both hands on her knees while looking toward the wide carriage window. Grab rings hang above the view of water and clouds.

pages.title: Spirited Away No-Face Holding Gold Coloring Page
pages.description: No-Face holds a tray of gold ingots in this printable coloring page, with two outlined sparkles beside the stacked bars and an oval mask above them. The cloak leaves broad open areas to color.

pages.title: Spirited Away Haku in Dragon Form Coloring Page
pages.description: Haku coils in dragon form in this printable coloring page, with a shaggy mane, long whiskers, and clawed feet beneath a segmented belly. The tufted tail curls forward along the ground.

pages.title: Kiki Flying on Her Broom with Jiji Coloring Page
pages.description: Kiki flies on her broom with Jiji in this printable coloring page, gripping the handle as the cat peeks out of her shoulder bag. Small buildings line the shore far below.

pages.title: Jiji and Lily Coloring Page
pages.description: Jiji and Lily sit together in this printable coloring page, with Jiji’s pointed ears beside Lily’s fluffy coat and ribbon bow. Rooftops and two clouds appear beyond the low wall.

pages.title: Kiki at the Bakery Coloring Page
pages.description: Kiki holds a loaf at the bakery in this printable coloring page, with Jiji sitting on the counter beside shelves of bread and an arched window. More loaves fill a basket beside her.
